releaseNotes:
Warrior TV Player 0.8.0

- Updates now arrive automatically: the app checks when it starts and once a day, or any time from Settings > About > Check for updates.
- Help & support: the diagnostics panel fits the screen, with Close always in view.
- Clearer setup: choose "Username & password" or "Playlist link" when adding a provider.
- Tidier screens: fewer technical terms throughout.
